description: Event catalogue for Insurance Product Distribution journey. Introduces 1 event: EVT-167. Published by SVC-004 (Insurance Distribution Service, CAP-001).

events.name: InsurancePolicyBound
events.trigger: Customer accepts insurance terms and IPID. Policy successfully bound with underwriter (Aviva). InsurancePolicy created with status = active.

consumers.action: Intra-capability: upgrade current account to Premier with insurance bundle fee.
Update customer app to display active insurance policy and management options.
Send policy confirmation email with certificate of insurance.
Write immutable insurance distribution record (FCA PROD / ICOBS evidence).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.insurance.
events.worm_rationale: Insurance distribution with Consumer Duty evidence is an FCA PROD record — immutable for regulatory audit.
